data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic context, the name "Lula" signifies the gentle flow of God's mercy and love. It represents the idea that just as a river flows continuously, providing sustenance and life, God's love and mercy envelops us all in a constant, flowing way. Additionally, the name can be seen as a reminder of the hadith, "Verily, Allah loves His servants, and He approves their actions when they love, love one another for His sake, and Hatred and envy, except amongst themselves" (Bukhari). Thus, the name "Lula" can also be interpreted as a call to spread love, compassion, and mercy among all people.
